factors.label: Rent & cost
factors.blurb: Market rent, home prices, how far a dollar goes, property tax.

factors.label: Safety
factors.blurb: Road, overdose and firearm deaths per 100k; crime where reported.

factors.label: Hurricane & hazard
factors.blurb: FEMA risk for hurricane, wildfire, heat, drought, tornado; hazard deaths; air quality.

factors.label: Climate
factors.blurb: Winter warmth, summer heat, rain and snow against your preferred band, plus the USDA amenity scale (mostly mild winters, sun and low humidity).

factors.label: Downtown & food
factors.blurb: Restaurants, bars, arts venues, gyms and shops, per resident and in total.

factors.label: Water & nature
factors.blurb: Terrain, how much of the county is water (lakes, rivers, coast), and park access.

factors.label: Church community
factors.blurb: Religious adherents as a share of residents (2020 US Religion Census).

factors.label: Health care
factors.blurb: Life expectancy, people per primary-care doctor, shortage areas.

factors.label: Flights to Europe
factors.blurb: European nonstops from the best airport within reach, and how far it is.

factors.label: Community
factors.blurb: Clubs and associations per resident, rootedness, median age.

factors.label: Town size & commute
factors.blurb: Population and density against your band, commute time, broadband, transit.

factors.label: Local jobs
factors.blurb: Unemployment, industry diversity, wages. Matters most if you need to find work there.

factors.label: Schools & childcare
factors.blurb: Graduation, staffing, spending, childcare cost. Matters most with children, now or planned.

layers.label: Religious adherence
layers.blurb: Share of residents who belong to a congregation (2020 US Religion Census).

layers.label: Political lean
layers.blurb: County two-party presidential margin, most recent election.
